entry.idea: FYLD turns everyday reports and photos from construction and infrastructure field workers into real-time, structured data so managers can see and fix problems fast.
entry.lesson: Turn the paperwork workers already have to do into structured data automatically, and safety and productivity improve as a side effect.
entry.name: FYLD

growth.reason: 82% year-over-year growth is fast and well documented, backed by concrete safety and productivity numbers from real customers.

market.reason: Infrastructure and construction fieldwork is a large, essential industry, though the product targets one part of it.

tech.reason: Using AI to read field images and video for safety and progress is useful, but similar computer-vision approaches could be built by a strong competitor within a year or two.

sources.title: FYLD: the startup using AI to keep site teams safe

entry.twist: It uses AI image analysis to automatically create video risk assessments of worksites, instead of relying on workers to fill out manual paperwork.
entry.who_pays: Infrastructure operators, contractors and utility companies pay to run their field operations and safety checks through the platform.
entry.why_now: Infrastructure operators face safety rules and labour shortages, and AI can now read images and video from the field reliably.
